CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `quotationGroups` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `department` varchar(100),
  `costCenterCode` varchar(50),
  `status` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'em_andamento',
  `selectedSupplierId` int,
  `requestId` int,
  `createdById` int NOT NULL,
  `createdByName` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `quotationSuppliers` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `groupId` int NOT NULL,
  `position` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `supplierName` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `supplierContact` varchar(255),
  `paymentTerms` varchar(255),
  `deliveryDays` int,
  `observations` text,
  `items` text NOT NULL,
  `totalValue` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `quotationSuppliers_groupId_idx` (`groupId`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
